title: One truck against a zombie horde and 10 giant bosses. I built it solo.
author: 105GamesDev
selftext:
Hi all,

I'm a solo developer, and this is the trailer for my game, Convoy Blast.



You drive one truck down a road of 100 stages. Hold to fire, slide to aim.

Every 10 stages a giant boss blocks the road. Each one fights its own way, and you can throw its bombs back at it.



There's also:

\- Escape stages where you spring traps on the horde

\- Robots that jump onto your truck and have to be knocked off

\- A drone mission where you blow up a dam

\- 5 trucks to upgrade



It's free on Android and PC.



Since I'm doing this alone, honest feedback means a lot: what caught your eye first in the trailer? And if you try it, which stage did you stop on, and why?  
Link to the game: [https://105games.github.io/convoyblast/](https://105games.github.io/convoyblast/)

Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

replies.author: 105GamesDev
replies.body: Thanks, updated the post with the full breakdown of how AI was used.

comments.author: Ravenravine2
comments.body: Considering its f2p at the moment, do you plan on monetizing it later on?

replies.author: 105GamesDev
replies.body: It’s free to play, and it already has ads and in-app purchases like coin and gold bar packs. They’re all optional, though. You can play and progress without spending anything. Right now I’m focused on growing the player base and making the game better, so I’m keeping the monetization light so it doesn’t get in the way of the fun.
